prompt.en: What did Sir Sandford Fleming invent?

options.en: The worldwide system of standard time zones.
options.fr: Le système mondial des fuseaux horaires standards.

options.en: The robotic arm used in space.
options.fr: Le bras robotisé utilisé dans l'espace.

explanation.en: Fleming worked out the system of standard time zones that the world still uses.
explanation.fr: Fleming a mis au point le système de fuseaux horaires standards que le monde utilise encore.

source.quote: Sir Sandford Fleming — invented the worldwide system of standard time zones.

verification.evidence: Sir Sandford Fleming — invented the worldwide system of standard time zones. • Matthew Evans and Henry Woodward
